links.outcome: Accuracy and recall of local input screening classifier for PHI detection, and latency
links.effect: Frozen local encoders reached >=98.3% accuracy on structured PHI detection in <=23.5 ms; fine-tuned BGE-Large reached 100.0% local recall on PHI violations.
links.quote: Per-policy error analysis reveals ceiling local recall on PHI (100.0%), brand (100.0%), and clinical scope (98.7%-99.3%) violations, isolating residual errors to reading-level checks (93.3%-95.3%) and motivating targeted multi-tier escalation.

links.outcome: Detection of out-of-scope clinical requests and over-refusal rate of safety classifier
links.effect: Fine-tuned BGE-Large reached 98.7%-99.3% recall on clinical scope violations, 97.8%-98.2% overall recall, and 0.0%-0.4% over-refusal; 98.90% accuracy vs 99.20% for cloud LLM judge.
